gates.fact: parcel_id must equal the canonical revision-5 CANDIDATES value
gates.guard: Reject renamed or inferred parcel_id

gates.fact: parcel_ref must equal the canonical revision-5 CANDIDATES value
gates.guard: Reject parcel_ref not present in revision-5 seed

gates.fact: candidate easting must equal the canonical revision-5 BNG seed
gates.guard: Reject guessed/reprojected easting as seed evidence

gates.fact: candidate northing must equal the canonical revision-5 BNG seed
gates.guard: Reject guessed/reprojected northing as seed evidence

gates.fact: revision-5 seed script blob SHA is 34fe21c8bce67f911fd692e3e3cabaf1702a1424
gates.guard: Reject seed provenance when blob identity differs

gates.fact: revision-6 loads revision-5 and iterates rev5.CANDIDATES
gates.guard: Reject candidate chain not inherited from revision-5

gates.fact: revision-7 executes revision-6 and preserves rows
gates.guard: Reject bulk-GML promotion without revision-6 output

gates.fact: revision-8 executes revision-7 and applies geometry/datum quality gates
gates.guard: Reject geometry quality promotion without revision-7 output

gates.fact: revision-14 remains the same logical task and continuation
gates.guard: Reject second logical task or alternate continuation

gates.fact: revision-14 authority scope is London Borough of Barnet and London Borough of Enfield
gates.guard: Reject unapproved authority substitution

gates.fact: revision-14 expects HMLR monthly publication date 2026-07-05
gates.guard: Reject stale/different monthly geometry without explicit revalidation

gates.fact: exact INSPIRE ID is required for candidate promotion
gates.guard: Keep candidate pending while INSPIRE ID is unresolved

gates.fact: candidate BNG point must be inside the matched fresh HMLR polygon
gates.guard: Reject nearest/fuzzy polygon match

gates.fact: fresh HMLR geometry must equal the geometry sampled by EA and OS
gates.guard: Reject numeric values sampled from a different geometry

gates.fact: identical cross-authority duplicate polygons may be deduplicated
gates.guard: Do not double-count identical Barnet/Enfield delivery

gates.fact: conflicting duplicate geometries must be rejected
gates.guard: Block candidate on conflicting Barnet/Enfield geometry

gates.fact: HMLR WFS is diagnostic only; monthly GML is acceptance geometry
gates.guard: Reject WFS-only measurement promotion

gates.fact: primary numeric source is Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1m
gates.guard: Reject inferred/secondary-only parcel range

gates.fact: minimum valid EA DTM 1m pixels inside polygon is 3
gates.guard: Reject max-minus-min when fewer than 3 valid pixels exist

gates.fact: EA values must be directly resampled at 1m pixel centres inside polygon
gates.guard: Reject centroid-only or non-pixel-centre substitute

gates.fact: height difference is maximum minus minimum valid EA DTM 1m pixel-centre elevations inside fresh HMLR polygon
gates.guard: Reject alternate range definition

gates.fact: horizontal CRS is EPSG:27700
gates.guard: Reject silent CRS mismatch

gates.fact: vertical CRS is EPSG:5701 / Ordnance Datum Newlyn
gates.guard: Reject ellipsoidal or unknown vertical datum

gates.fact: EA source accuracy metadata remains part of the uncertainty context
gates.guard: Do not equate stored numeric precision with physical accuracy

gates.fact: OS Terrain 50 is independent absolute elevation/ODN crosscheck, not parcel-range measurement
gates.guard: Reject OS Terrain 50 max-minus-min as parcel result

gates.fact: OS Terrain 50 crosscheck uses the official grid cell at the HMLR representative point
gates.guard: Reject unrelated tile/cell

gates.fact: EA-vs-OS absolute elevation difference above 8.0m is a conflict
gates.guard: Block measured promotion when >8.0m

gates.fact: nearest, fuzzy and point-only HMLR fallback is forbidden
gates.guard: Leave NO_DATA/PENDING instead of guessing boundary

gates.fact: revision-14 runtime output 016 must exist before candidate numeric promotion
gates.guard: Block all three candidates while output 016 is absent

gates.fact: revision-14 integrity readback 025 must exist and pass before promotion
gates.guard: Block all three candidates while integrity readback is absent
